risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and provides concrete evidence of recovery, including improved capital ratios, reduced nonperforming assets, lower credit costs, and a return to profitability. However, it retains meaningful risk exposure through Hawaii- and California-focused real estate lending, weak prior-year losses, regulatory history, and uncertain macroeconomic conditions. Forward-looking caveats and limited assurance language temper the otherwise cautiously positive tone.
